description: This file contains unit tests for GatewayConnectionController in a Swift project, testing various behaviors such as display name resolution, capability toggles, command generation, operator connection options, approval scope requests, and last connection persistence.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionControllerTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests verifying the behavior of GatewayConnectionController and related functionality, focusing on display name handling, capability toggles, command inclusion, operator connection options, and persistent connection data.

methods.name: resolvedDisplayNameSetsDefaultWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the default display name is set correctly when missing from user defaults.

methods.name: currentCapsReflectToggles
methods.description: Verifies that current capabilities reflect the toggled states in user defaults.

methods.name: currentCommandsIncludeLocationWhenEnabled
methods.description: Checks that location commands are included when enabled in user defaults.

methods.name: currentCommandsExcludeDangerousSystemExecCommands
methods.description: Ensures that system commands like shell execution are excluded for safety.

methods.name: operatorConnectOptionsOnlyRequestApprovalScopeWhenEnabled
methods.description: Verifies operator connect options include approval scope only when enabled.

methods.name: operatorApprovalScopeRequestsStayBackwardCompatible
methods.description: Checks backward compatibility for operator approval scope requests based on stored scopes.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReadsSavedValues
methods.description: Tests that the last connection data is correctly read from storage.

methods.name: loadLastConnectionReturnsNilForInvalidData
methods.description: Ensures invalid stored data results in nil when loading last connection.
